add_library(cache_storage STATIC lru_storage.cpp)
target_link_libraries(cache_storage PUBLIC http core Threads::Threads)
target_compile_features(cache_storage PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(cache_storage PROPERTIES CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(cache_storage PRIVATE /W4)
else()
    target_compile_options(cache_storage PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)
endif()
